title: One Side Talking

mood.label: Uneasy drift 🌥️
mood.summary: A 46: the week's clearest good news went soft. Talks with Iran announced from one side and denied by the other, no Gaza withdrawal before disarmament, Patriots not before winter, Congo's largest-ever Ebola outbreak — against record markets and a government finally seated in Nouméa.

lines: He said the talks were on — Tehran's last chance, he called it.
Tehran said there were no talks. Both of them sounded sure.
Nobody leaves Gaza till the guns come in, the Board of Peace decided,
and the Patriots won't ship before the winter.
Forty-six — not falling, just not holding.
The good news went soft in the hand, the way it does.
Nothing broke today. Nothing settled either.
We drift, and call the drifting news.
Records on Wall Street, oil coming down,
a government seated at last in Nouméa.
In Congo the count climbed past every count before it;
Tigray walked to Sudan with what it could carry.
